methods.A3: Direction-only whole-physical-client control using A4 region risks; within-region mean of valid duplicate-slot risks; region-numel-weighted mean over valid regions; gate=exp(-4*risk); normalized covering-slot weights on local learning increments, preserve native dispatch fusion
methods.A4: Original ScopeHooks s03; conflict_lambda=4; original region/slot direction evidence

panel: All 100 previously materialized training probes, same 32-image batch per physical client and model; Full model only. Equal client mean, then equal cohort mean. Also report participating/nonparticipating and fixed physical capacity groups cid0-39/40-69/70-99. No new images or SGD.
scale_analysis: No search: rescale each A1-A4 full learning increment to A0 L2; also rescale A0 increment to A4 L2. Scales depend only on weights, never CE. These are analysis controls, not additional proposed methods.
limitations: One mature E03 anchor, five dependent upload cohorts, training probes; no test accuracy or peak-performance claim. A3/A4 differ in global risk pooling and duplicate-slot pooling as well as intervention scope.
